title: Hindenburgstraße, Denzlingen
description:
Minimum stay: 2 months
Maximum stay: 4 months
Not suitable for shared living – rental to single persons only

Only available for demonstrable short-term stays - like academic studies, research project, project work, etc.

Fully furnished and very cozy 2.5-room apartment with private terrace and a green view. Ideal for nature lovers who still want to live close to the center.

Perfect for dual students, visiting researchers, or professionals with a temporary stay in the region.

The apartment is on the ground floor of a multi-family house, centrally located in Denzlingen. Supermarkets, restaurants, pharmacies, a drugstore, and the train/bus station are all within walking distance. Freiburg main station can be reached in just a few minutes by train.

Details:

The apartment is used by the owner when not rented
Rent: €950 (incl. utilities)
Security deposit: €(hidden) (depending on the length of your stay)
Tourist stays are strictly prohibited by local authorities

No smoking, no pets

Upon request: linen package (bed linen + towels) available for a one-time fee of €50

Amenities:

Fully equipped kitchen
Senseo coffee machine
Microwave
Stove with oven
Basic cookware and dishes
Wi-Fi
Washing machine (shared, in utility room of main building)
Private terrace


Feel free to contact me if you have any  questions

Sonstiges
Contact via email

title: Habsburgerstraße, Freiburg
description:
***SAVE NOW with the 1-month-cold-rent-free offer from May***

Welcome to our new residences in Freiburg-Mitte! You will find us in the heart of the most beautiful university town in the Black Forest. Just a few minutes' walk from Freiburg's shopping center, Kaiser-Joseph-Straße, this all-inclusive package will make your student life unforgettable:

In our house at Habsburgerstraße, 344 fully furnished modern student apartments, with pantry kitchen and bathroom, are waiting to be filled with life. Not only may you choose the size and location of your apartment, but also between single or double apartments.
With us you will find the perfect combination of private living space and a great community. Get to know your roommates in the spacious lounge or while cooking in the communal kitchen. In the study room you can work concentrated, or exchange with others. In the Gaming Room you may enjoy a game of football or the Play Station to blow off some steam in between learning sessions. Furthermore you will meet our house manager in the lobby, who always has an open ear for you.

The highlight of the house: On the upper floors you may enjoy scenic views of the Black Forest and even France!


JUST MOVE IN AND FEEL GOOD

Our house manager will take care of your concerns from the time you move in and among others, accept your packages or rent out household items (e.g. vacuum cleaner, iron) free of charge. Additional security is provided by a central main entrance to which you only have access through a chip as well as video surveillance of all entrances.


YOUR APARTMENT

Your apartment offers you a living area with bed incl. mattress, desk with chair, wardrobe with mirror, light-tight curtains, intercom and generous storage space. The pantry kitchen is equipped with two ceramic hobs, combi microwave, fridge with a freezer, a sink and counter.
The modern tiled shower room offers toilet, washbasin with mirror and further storage options. All services and additional costs such as heating and hot water, as well as internet are included in the rent.

*The photos shown are just examples of how the apartment could look like.


LOCATION
Your new apartment in Freiburg Mitte is just a few minutes' walk from Freiburg's shopping center, Kaiser-Joseph-Straße. In addition, there are very good transport links by bus and train. Right on your doorstep you will find various shops, such as drugstores, shopping markets, as well as restaurants and doctors.


YOUR HIGHTLIGHTS

• All-in rent (incl. electricity, heating, water, -costs and internet at a monthly flat rate)
• Common areas: gaming room, kitchen, lobby, study room, lounge area, laundry room
• Bicycle cellar: Park your bike safely in the lockable bicycle cellar
• Underground car park: Your car is also safe in our underground car park.
• Parcel counter during opening hours at the reception
• Free rental of household appliances (vacuum cleaner, iron, etc.)
• Exclusive partner deals: save also outside at selected locations with your member card
• Regular events and activities
• A community that offers you the opportunity to turn your neighbours into friends.

YOUR ALL-IN PRICE

In our community,  you get a complete living concept and not just an apartment! Your all-in price includes the following services:
Apartment services

•	Apartment
•	Furniture
•	Utilities (water, electricity)
•	Internet

Living Services

•	Reception/House Management/House Technician
•	Rental items (vacuum cleaner, iron, games, etc.)
•	Parcel acceptance
•	Common rooms
•	Events

Tip: Benefit from the best offer: The earlier you book and the longer you stay, the better the price offer will be.

-💡NOTE:
•  Admission fee:
         ** 6-9 Month = 249€
         **10 Month and more = 99€
•  The deposit is 3x the monthly cold rent.

**Please note that the rent written on the listing is (hidden) rent. There is a surcharge for quieter apartments facing the courtyard or for apartments on a higher floor level. If you are interested, do let us know and we will send you the offer!

title: Eugen-Martin-Straße, Freiburg
description:
The modern furnished studio offers a double bed, a fully equipped kitchen, a working area, a bathroom with shower and toilet, flat screen TV, air conditioning and free Wi-Fi.
The apartment is comfortably furnished. Fully equipped kitchen, multifunctional working and living area, modern bathroom: you will feel like at home while benefiting from our full range of services. 

Weekly cleaning as well as changing bed sheets and towels is included in the price. Cleaning also possible on request.

- Parking in the parking garage of the building: EUR 18,00 per night
- Washing machine (EUR 4 per load) and dryer (EUR 2 per load) as well as an iron are located inside the building (not inside the studio apartment) available to the guests in the building.
- Guests bringing their pets: EUR 5,00 - 10,00 per night.

In just 10 minutes you can reach the city center by streetcar, putting you in a prime location. Discover Freiburg, the southernmost city in Germany, the Freiburg Cathedral and the historical buildings or admire the pretty alleys of the Klein-Venedig district. The Messe Freiburg, Sick Arena and the new stadium of the SC Freiburg are also in the immediate vicinity.
